verdict.rationale: Firecrawl's README says it covers 96% of the web with "no proxy headaches" (firecrawl-gh-8), which implies managed proxy handling. But nothing documents a rotating IP pool, proxy selection, or developer-controlled routing. A community commenter says Firecrawl lacks a proxy service (firecrawl-comm-3), though that may refer to the open-source build, since the cloud version has extra features (firecrawl-gh-6). Missing for 10: explicit docs of a rotating proxy pool, developer-configurable proxy options (e.g. residential or geo), and hands-on corroboration that requests route through rotating IPs to avoid blocks.
